annotations.title: Verify a US business (Florida, New York, California and Colorado records)

description: Looks up a company by name in the public company records of Florida, New York, California and Colorado. With state (FL, NY, CA or CO) it checks that state only; without it, every state, for when the state the company is registered in is not known. This tool is free: it checks the name, lists the legal names of up to 3 candidate companies in each state it checks while the hourly free preview lasts (one free check per state from a shared allowance), says in which states a candidate was found, and returns each state's pay URL for that state's full lookup, with each state's data dates. Each state's full lookup costs 0.10 USDC over x402 v2 on Base, paid at that state's pay URL, and is charged even when nothing matches. A state whose data is out of date, or could not be read or searched just now, gets no pay URL. The buyer's own x402 wallet pays; this server never receives payment, signatures or keys. A no match result is not proof that a company does not exist. Not affiliated with the Florida Department of State, the New York Department of State, the California Secretary of State or the Colorado Department of State.

business_name.description: The company name to look up, such as Publix Super Markets. 2 to 200 characters.

max_results.description: How many candidate companies each state's paid lookup returns, 1 to 5. Default 5.

state.description: Optional. The state to check: FL (Florida), NY (New York), CA (California) or CO (Colorado). The state's name works too. Leave it out to check every state.
